sources.entry: Min Browser - A fast and efficient minimal web browser.

summary.one_liner: Min is a fast, minimal, privacy-focused web browser with a distraction-reducing interface, built with Node/Electron-style npm tooling.
summary.what_it_does: Min is a desktop web browser that includes full-text search over visited pages, ad and tracker blocking, automatic reader view, Tasks (tab groups), bookmark tagging, password manager integration, and a dark theme. Its interface is designed to minimize distractions. The README says prebuilt binaries are available from the releases page and that userscripts can extend it. Developers can run it in development mode with npm and build binaries for Windows, macOS (Intel and Arm), Debian, Red Hat, and Raspberry Pi/ARM Linux. The README also covers translation contribution via localization JSON files.
how_to_run: Download a prebuilt binary from the releases page
Linux: sudo dpkg -i /path/to/download (.deb) or sudo rpm -i /path/to/download --ignoreos (RPM)
Clone the repo, install Node, then run: npm install
Start in development mode: npm run start
Build binaries with npm run buildWindows, buildMacIntel, buildMacArm, buildDebian, buildRaspi, buildLinuxArm64, or buildRedhat
notable: Built-in ad and tracker blocking with automatic reader view
Userscript support with a community script collection
caveats: macOS builds need Xcode and may require setting SDKROOT to macOS 11.0 or higher
Windows builds need Visual Studio, and may need msvs_version configured
Install methods vary by platform; some (Arch via AUR, Raspberry Pi via Pi-Apps) rely on third-party channels
